newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends higher after NY rally.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends higher after NY rally.

text.p: London white sugar futures saw a last minute rally on Friday on the back of fund buying in New York.
The benchmark August position finished the day $2.00 higher at $309.10 a tonne after having seen a peak of $312.50.
The nearby August/October spread widened on the day with the rolling of spot positions into August, but traders said the spread was likely to slide down in the coming days.
Volume on LIFFE sugar contracts totalled 2,459 lots.
In late news, Iran emerged as the possible buyer of four cargoes of white sugar this week for shipment between May and July. Previously Iran was reported to have bought three cargoes.

New York raw values surged to their highest levels in a week on Friday after technically-inspired fund activity. At 1730 GMT the July contract was hovering above resistance of 11.00 cents a lb at 11.10 cents, up 0.22.
